## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier-1 surgical frozen section with medial margin involvement (323 um); stains blocked for frozen sections.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% [F1] | Strong invasive score (ECE 5%) |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% target (90% test coverage) | Single class at 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100% OOD, 12/12 regions kept [F6] | Atypical embeddings; unflagged input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True (same top class) | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 4/5 (80%) Invasive (70%–80% similarity); 1/5 InSitu [F5] | Mostly invasive; InSitu contrast case |

## Tissue evidence
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 3, 9) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (0.80 contribution) [F2], but 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical (0.63 contribution); scarcity pushes toward invasive; caption inconsistent [F3] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical (0.61 contribution); scarcity pushes toward invasive; 0/20 spot check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 2) · context · Descriptive only (0.45 contribution); differs from InSitu contrast (8/20 spot check) · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 9, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (0.30 contribution); 18/20 AI spot check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability 1% over random (95% CI excludes 0).
- **Concepts**: Unverified faithfulness (deletion 95% CI includes 0); leans on Unreliable mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- In situ mimics invasion; contrast case BACH_0197 is InSitu (69% similarity), differing in invasion and lymphocytes.
- Severity-3 resample degradation (simulated frozen section) distorts morphology; reliability error AUROC is 70% and cell segmentation is disabled.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 4, 8**: Verify stromal invasion (top in **0**) and medial margin involvement (323 um) [F7].
2. **Regions 9, 10, 11**: Check nuclear pleomorphism and scarce tubules in **10** (peak risk in **4, 9**).
3. **Regions 2, 3, 7**: Confirm mitoses manually (**2, 3, 9**, Unreliable score) and check duct confinement (**7**).
